comment: Provider guide conventions. Edit here, not in code. See 'Provider guide findings' in docs/requirements.md.
nameTimesComment: Event times written into channel names: shown in the Roku's local time, and used by My Teams. pattern: a regex whose capture groups are listed in order (year, month, monthName, day, hour, minute, ampm); zone: a key in timezones. A missing year means the current year. The first matching rule wins. display: false uses a rule for My Teams only, without rewriting the name.

nameTimes.comment: NFL Game Pass style: 'NFL GP 03 | Rams @ Eagles (2026-10-04 17:00:00)'. UTC: a 1:00 PM ET kickoff is listed as 17:00.
ESPN style: 'ESPN UNLTD 092: Volleyball: Alabama vs. #8 Texas (10.04 01:00 PM ET)'.
'NCAAF 01: #7 Alabama vs. #16 Mississippi State @ 3 Oct 12:00 PM ET'.
'NHL 01: Winnipeg Jets vs Detroit Red Wings @ Oct 04 01:00 PM ET', 'OHL 01 | ... OCT 04 01:00PM ET'.
'DAZN UK 02: Força Lleida vs. CB San Pablo Burgos @ 4 Oct 11:00 AM London'.
No zone given ('NBA 01: Nuggets vs Jazz @ 4 Oct 07:00 PM'): the provider's usual US Eastern.

myTeamsComment: My Teams: games for saved teams found in event-channel names. eventCategories: live categories to scan (regexes on the category name). sports: the fixed sport list. sportRules: first pattern matching the category name plus channel name (lower case) decides the sport. separators: how a matchup's two sides are joined. replayWords: names containing these are replays. laterLanguages: channels with these words are listed after the others for the same game. Times in hours.

myTeams.networksComment: Network broadcasts: these national channels' short guides are searched for teams (title first, then description), plus the local stations of the device's market (Settings -> Local stations). By guide ID, so renumbering doesn't matter; among channels sharing a guide ID, the first whose name doesn't match networkAvoid is used.
myTeams.localStationsComment: Local stations: channels in categories matching localCategories (the capture group is the network) whose names match localName ('GA | Atlanta | ABC 2 WSB': state, city, station). A market is a state and city.

episodeTitleComment: Episode titles often repeat the series name and code ('The Last Kingdom (2015) - S01E01 - Episode 1'). In the episode list, everything up to and including a match of this pattern is dropped ('Episode 1'), unless that would leave nothing.
channelMatchingComment: Re-finding saved channels and series after the provider renumbers them. Names are compared lower-case, with these patterns (regexes) removed first, then punctuation; so 'ESPN (1080p)' matches 'ESPN HD'.
usageComment: Usage-based ordering within home rows. Each use adds a point; points halve every halfLifeDays. A channel counts as viewed after channelViewSeconds on it. At most maxEntries are kept (lowest scores dropped).
timeshiftComment: Catch-up archive. archiveLagSeconds: how far behind live the archive is reliably recorded (it's written in one-minute segments, each available only after its minute ends). Rewind and resume never ask for anything newer.
timezonesComment: For timeshift URLs, which take server-local times (server_info.timezone). Offsets in minutes from UTC; dst: 'eu' (last Sunday Mar to last Sunday Oct, 01:00 UTC), 'us' (2nd Sunday Mar to 1st Sunday Nov, 02:00 local), or '' for none.
